long_biography.plain_text:
At L'Ile Fantastique, Fabienne Collé shares board responsibility for a Lausanne foundation designed to provide practical social support. Its mandate covers micro-enterprises, children and families in difficulty, relief from precarity and routes back into work, mainly in French-speaking Switzerland.

Collé also appears in Swiss commercial-register records as an authorised signatory for several Anco companies, while Anthony Collé occupies their board leadership roles. The couple are members of the Lausanne Opera's circle of patrons. In another public collaboration, landscape architect Emma Voit developed the protected garden of their nineteenth-century Lausanne house with Fabienne and Anthony as the owners and clients.
